dialogues.speaker: Berbere
dialogues.text: Friend, have you heard the legend of the Dance of Sabzeruz? Would you like to feel the breath of the Goddess of Flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Berbere
dialogues.text: If you think that the Goddess of Flowers can bring only the fragrance of Padisarah, then you're practically blind. The spices of Sumeru are hardly so one-note!

dialogues.speaker: Berbere
dialogues.text: Such complex and mysterious scents can only be felt here!
